_comment: How dangerous a written Age is, before it exists (design 7.7). Every value is on one scale: how much more
dangerous a hazard makes an Age than the vanilla overworld, which is 0. The Nether is about 0.5, the End a
little under it, and deretheni begins at `lines.pays_at`. Rated by play, hazard by hazard, as a book writes it
by default; `/age instability <name> danger` prints each hazard an Age holds and the score they make.
`combining`: hazards combine as the n-th root of the sum of their n-th powers. 1 would add them; 2 is their
root-sum-square. 1.5 is what fitted the combinations rated together.
`lines`: deretheni from `pays_at`, and its deposit reads as little, some, much and immense from the lines
named so. `ruins_below` is where the D'ni city stops, placed apart from the deposits.
`confined` is what a claim confined to one biome keeps of the same claim made everywhere.
`ground`: what the Age stands on (worst of rock and surface, by block id), its seas (by fluid id), a sea deep
enough for an abyss, landforms over the void by landform key (counted only with no sea beneath), landforms
dangerous in themselves (the Nether's, whose own crowd and dark come with it), and the underground by key.
Each covers the share of the Age it covers.
`creatures` and `darkness` feed one hazard, the monsters, and the worst of them counts: more monsters,
monsters let out at every hour, and the biomes' own made harder are one danger met three ways. `monsters` is
any monster without its own line, and what a crowd described rather than named is worth for the share of all
monsters it reaches. The whole scales by the monster cap the book set (teeming holds about four), and
`hardiness` by how the book changed them: each dial is the multiple at its top and bottom, in a straight line
between. A small creature is as dangerous as its own, weaker but harder to hit. `loosed` is a creature that
turns up anywhere, past its own rules. Darkness lets out the overworld's monsters, so it counts nothing over
the Nether's and the End's own landforms.
`features`: the worst one named counts, as one hazard.
`phenomena` lists the sights at nothing so that a missing entry reads as an oversight. `phenomenon_dials`
scale a written phenomenon by how often and how hard it comes; an inflicted one scores by how far it was bought.
`gravity`: a little while a block can still be jumped, and `unjumpable` from `unjumpable_from` times vanilla's.
`wounds` is what a full reach of them is worth.
